cases.name: doc-sel-every-condition-valid
cases.note: Every condition with valid values; the control for the condition cases below.

cases.name: doc-sel-every-condition-deny-valid
cases.note: Uninstall in Operations, which allows neither Version nor a selector naming a source; NonElevated; AnySource for a manager the trusted list does not name.

cases.name: doc-sel-repeated-entries-valid
cases.note: A list other than Rules may repeat an entry.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-empty-invalid
cases.note: Operations is a non-empty list. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Operations is a list, not a single value. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-entry-wrong-type
cases.note: Each entry is a string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-install-case-invalid
cases.note: 'install' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-repair-invalid

cases.note: 'Uninstall ' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-scopes-empty-invalid
cases.note: Scopes is a non-empty list. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-scopes-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Scopes is a list, not a single value. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-scopes-entry-wrong-type
cases.note: Each entry is a string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-scopes-user-case-invalid
cases.note: 'user' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-scopes-global-invalid
cases.note: 'Global' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-empty-invalid
cases.note: Architectures is a non-empty list. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Architectures is a list, not a single value. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-entry-wrong-type
cases.note: Each entry is a string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-x64-case-invalid
cases.note: 'x64' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-arm64-invalid
cases.note: 'ARM64' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-architectures-amd64-invalid
cases.note: 'AMD64' is not a value of §request-properties; values match only with their exact characters (§text-comparison). Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-operations-second-entry-invalid
cases.note: The pointer is the entry outside the domain. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-elevation-standard-invalid
cases.note: Standard is a Client.RequestedElevation value, not an elevation; elevations are NonElevated and Elevated.

cases.name: doc-sel-elevation-lowercase-invalid
cases.note: Closed-set values match only with their exact characters.

cases.name: doc-sel-elevation-array-wrong-type
cases.note: Elevation is one elevation string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-elevation-null-wrong-type
cases.note: Elevation is one elevation string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-elevation-boolean-wrong-type
cases.note: Elevation is one elevation string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-empty-invalid
cases.note: Sources is a non-empty list. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-object-wrong-type
cases.note: Sources is a list of selectors.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-conflict
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-missing-source
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-any-source-false-invalid
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-manager-invalid
cases.note: Manager identifiers match with exact characters.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-manager-missing
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-unknown-key
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-entry-wrong-type
cases.note: An entry is a source selector object. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-empty-invalid
cases.note: Packages is a non-empty list. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-empty-pattern-invalid
cases.note: A pattern is a non-empty string. Control: doc-sel-packages-unusual-patterns-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-second-pattern-empty-invalid
cases.note: A pattern is a non-empty string. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-unusual-patterns-valid
cases.note: Any non-empty string is a pattern, including one made of '*', a space, or characters no package id holds.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Packages is a list of strings. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-packages-entry-wrong-type
cases.note: Packages is a list of strings. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-unknown-condition
cases.note: Managers is not a condition; a selection names managers through Sources.

cases.name: doc-sel-singular-key-unknown
cases.note: The condition is Sources; Source is unknown at a selection.

cases.name: doc-sel-null-condition-wrong-type
cases.note: null is a value of the wrong type wherever it appears; an absent condition and a null one differ.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-unknown-condition
cases.note: An Except entry is a selection with the same conditions. Control: doc-rule-except-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-operations-invalid
cases.note: Control: doc-rule-except-valid. §errors: the pointer is the value, which is the entry when the defect is in one entry of a list.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-scopes-wrong-type
cases.note: Control: doc-rule-except-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-sources-missing-source
cases.note: Control: doc-rule-except-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid
cases.note: A condition with only Prerelease constrains the version, so it is not empty.

cases.name: doc-vercond-empty-invalid
cases.note: A version condition with none of its keys constrains nothing. Controls: doc-vercond-minimum-valid, doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-prerelease-lowercase-invalid
cases.note: Prerelease has the one value Exclude, with exact characters. Control: doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-prerelease-include-invalid
cases.note: Prerelease has the one value Exclude, with exact characters. Control: doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-prerelease-empty-invalid
cases.note: Prerelease has the one value Exclude, with exact characters. Control: doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-prerelease-boolean-wrong-type
cases.note: Prerelease is a string. Control: doc-vercond-prerelease-only-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-minimum-number-wrong-type
cases.note: A version is a string. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-maximum-null-wrong-type
cases.note: Control: doc-vercond-maximum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-unknown-key
cases.note: Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Version is a version condition object. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-null-wrong-type
cases.note: Version is a version condition object. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-array-wrong-type
cases.note: Version is a version condition object. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-without-operations-missing
cases.note: A selection with Version also has Operations. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-without-operations-deny-missing
cases.note: The rule binds Deny rules too.

cases.name: doc-vercond-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Operations listing Uninstall conflicts with Version; the pointer is Version. Control: doc-vercond-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-install-and-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Uninstall anywhere in Operations conflicts. Control: doc-vercond-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-except-without-operations-missing
cases.note: An Except entry with Version needs its own Operations, even when the rule's Select lists operations. Control: doc-vercond-except-valid.

cases.name: doc-vercond-except-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Control: doc-vercond-except-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-one-component-valid
cases.note: '1' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-five-components-valid
cases.note: '1.2.3.4.5' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-leading-zeros-valid
cases.note: '01.002' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-lowercase-v-valid
cases.note: 'v1.0' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-uppercase-v-valid
cases.note: 'V1.0' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-zero-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0-0' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-zeros-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0-0.0' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-alphanumeric-leading-zero-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0-01a' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-hyphen-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0-alpha-beta' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-only-hyphen-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0--' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-empty-build-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0+' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-build-dots-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0+..' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-build-leading-zeros-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0+001' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-and-build-valid
cases.note: '1.0.0-rc.1+build.5' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-one-component-pre-release-valid
cases.note: '1-a' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-huge-component-valid
cases.note: '99999999999999999999999999.0' is a version under the §version-scheme grammar.

cases.name: doc-version-empty-invalid
cases.note: '' is not a version: it has no release component. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-letters-invalid
cases.note: 'abc' is not a version: it has no release component. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-v-only-invalid
cases.note: 'v' is not a version: it has no release component. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-double-v-invalid
cases.note: 'vv1' is not a version: only one v precedes the release. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-trailing-dot-invalid
cases.note: '1.' is not a version: a release component follows each '.'. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-leading-dot-invalid
cases.note: '.1' is not a version: a release component precedes each '.'. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-empty-component-invalid
cases.note: '1..2' is not a version: a release component follows each '.'. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-empty-pre-release-invalid
cases.note: '1.0-' is not a version: a pre-release follows '-'. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-trailing-dot-invalid
cases.note: '1.0-a.' is not a version: each pre-release identifier is non-empty. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-empty-pre-release-identifier-invalid
cases.note: '1.0-a..b' is not a version: each pre-release identifier is non-empty. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-leading-zero-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0-01' is not a version: a numeric pre-release identifier has no leading zero (SemVer 2.0.0 item 9). Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-zeros-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0-rc.00' is not a version: a numeric pre-release identifier has no leading zero. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-pre-release-underscore-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0-a_b' is not a version: a pre-release identifier holds ASCII letters, digits and '-' only. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-second-plus-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0+a+b' is not a version: build metadata holds ASCII letters, digits, '-' and '.' only. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-build-underscore-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0+a_b' is not a version: build metadata holds ASCII letters, digits, '-' and '.' only. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-build-only-invalid
cases.note: '+1' is not a version: a release component comes first. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-trailing-space-invalid
cases.note: '1.0 ' is not a version: no other character is allowed. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-leading-space-invalid
cases.note: ' 1.0' is not a version: no other character is allowed. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-trailing-v-invalid
cases.note: '1.0v' is not a version: v may only lead. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-comma-invalid
cases.note: '1,0' is not a version: components are separated by '.'. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-non-ascii-pre-release-invalid
cases.note: '1.0.0-α' is not a version: U+03B1 is not an ASCII letter. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-non-ascii-digits-invalid
cases.note: '١.٠' is not a version: U+0661 and U+0660 are not ASCII digits. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-wildcard-invalid
cases.note: '1.x' is not a version: x is not a digit. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-range-invalid
cases.note: '>=1.0' is not a version: a version has no comparison operator. Control: doc-vercond-minimum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-maximum-not-version-invalid
cases.note: Maximum is checked like Minimum. Control: doc-vercond-maximum-valid.

cases.name: doc-version-minimum-not-version-with-maximum
cases.note: Minimum is not a version, so it cannot be higher than Maximum; the one defect is at Minimum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-numeric-components-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.9, Maximum 1.10: 9 < 10 numerically, though '1.9' sorts after '1.10' as text, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-numeric-components-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.10, Maximum 1.9: 10 > 9 numerically, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-trailing-zero-equal-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.2.0, Maximum 1.2: missing trailing components count as zero, so they are equal, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-trailing-zeros-equal-reversed-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.2, Maximum 1.2.0.0: missing trailing components count as zero, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-missing-component-zero-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.2.1, Maximum 1.2: 1.2 is 1.2.0, lower than 1.2.1, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-leading-zero-equal-valid
cases.note: Minimum 01.2, Maximum 1.2: components compare numerically whatever their leading zeros, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-v-prefix-invalid
cases.note: Minimum v2, Maximum 1.5: v2 is 2, higher than 1.5, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-equal-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0, Maximum 1.0.0: equal bounds, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-below-release-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-rc.1, Maximum 1.0.0: a pre-release is lower than the same release, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-below-release-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0, Maximum 1.0.0-rc.1: a pre-release is lower than the same release, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-numeric-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-alpha.9, Maximum 1.0.0-alpha.10: numeric identifiers compare numerically (SemVer 2.0.0 item 11), so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-numeric-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-alpha.10, Maximum 1.0.0-alpha.9: alpha.10 > alpha.9 numerically (SemVer 2.0.0 item 11), so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-more-fields-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-alpha.1, Maximum 1.0.0-alpha: a larger set of identifiers has higher precedence when the preceding ones are equal (SemVer 2.0.0 item 11), so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-numeric-below-alphanumeric-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-a, Maximum 1.0.0-1: a numeric identifier is lower than an alphanumeric one (SemVer 2.0.0 item 11), so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-ascii-order-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-B, Maximum 1.0.0-a: alphanumeric identifiers compare in ASCII order, and 'B' (0x42) < 'a' (0x61), so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-ascii-order-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-a, Maximum 1.0.0-B: 'a' (0x61) > 'B' (0x42) in ASCII order, so a case-insensitive comparison gets this wrong, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-build-ignored-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0+2, Maximum 1.0.0+1: build metadata never affects a comparison, so they are equal, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-build-ignored-pre-release-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-rc.1+b, Maximum 1.0.0-rc.1: build metadata never affects a comparison, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-trailing-zero-equal-valid
cases.note: Minimum 1.2.0-rc, Maximum 1.2-rc: equal releases (1.2 is 1.2.0) and equal pre-releases, so the Minimum is not higher than the Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-beyond-u64-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 18446744073709551616, Maximum 18446744073709551615: 2^64 > 2^64 - 1 numerically; a 64-bit parse overflows, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-version-order-pre-release-beyond-u64-invalid
cases.note: Minimum 1.0.0-alpha.18446744073709551616, Maximum 1.0.0-alpha.18446744073709551615: numeric pre-release identifiers compare numerically, and 2^64 > 2^64 - 1, so the Minimum is higher than the Maximum; §version-condition puts the error at Maximum.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-unreadable-name-valid
cases.note: A selector in a selection may name a source that no readable request carries: ' winget' starts with White_Space (§reading). §source-selector asks only for a non-empty string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-other-npm-name-valid
cases.note: Npm's only source name is 'npm' (§manager-npm), so no readable request matches 'registry'. §source-selector asks only for a non-empty string. Control: doc-sel-every-condition-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-missing-operations
cases.note: A selection whose Sources names a source also has Operations. Control: doc-sel-named-source-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-deny-missing-operations
cases.note: The rule binds Deny rules too. Control: doc-sel-named-source-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Operations listing Uninstall beside a selector naming a source; the pointer is Sources. Control: doc-sel-named-source-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-install-and-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Uninstall anywhere in Operations conflicts. Control: doc-sel-named-source-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-any-source-without-operations-valid
cases.note: Only a selector with Source needs Operations; AnySource selects uninstalls too. Contrast doc-sel-named-source-missing-operations.

cases.name: doc-sel-any-source-uninstall-valid
cases.note: AnySource beside Operations listing Uninstall is valid. Contrast doc-sel-named-source-uninstall-conflict.

cases.name: doc-sel-mixed-sources-missing-operations
cases.note: A selector naming a source needs Operations even beside an AnySource selector. Control: doc-sel-any-source-without-operations-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-named-source-missing-operations
cases.note: An Except entry naming a source needs its own Operations, even when the rule's Select lists operations. Control: doc-sel-except-named-source-install-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-except-named-source-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: Control: doc-sel-except-named-source-install-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-version-and-named-source-missing-operations
cases.note: Both Version and a selector naming a source require Operations, and the selection has one error, MissingKey at Operations. Control: doc-sel-version-and-named-source-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-version-and-named-source-uninstall-conflict
cases.note: When both rules find Uninstall in Operations, the selection has two errors, ConflictingKeys at Version and at Sources; with several errors a non-empty subset is reported (§errors). Control: doc-sel-version-and-named-source-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-conflict-without-operations
cases.note: A selector with both Source and AnySource beside no Operations: ConflictingKeys at AnySource, and a selector with Source, so MissingKey at Operations. Contrast doc-sel-sources-conflict.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-unknown-key-without-operations
cases.note: A selector naming a source with an unknown key beside no Operations: two defects. Contrast doc-sel-sources-unknown-key.

cases.name: doc-sel-sources-neither-key-without-operations
cases.note: A selector without the Source key does not trigger the Operations requirement, so the selection needs no Operations and the only error is MissingKey at Source. Contrast doc-sel-named-source-missing-operations.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-empty-value-without-operations
cases.note: A Sources entry with the key Source requires Operations whatever its value; the empty Source is a second defect, so a non-empty subset is reported (§errors). Contrast doc-sel-named-source-empty-value-install.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-empty-value-install
cases.note: With Operations [Install], the empty Source is the only defect. Control: doc-sel-named-source-install-update-valid.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-null-value-without-operations
cases.note: A null Source still has the key Source, so the selection requires Operations; the null is a second defect, so a non-empty subset is reported (§errors). Contrast doc-sel-sources-neither-key-without-operations.

cases.name: doc-sel-named-source-operations-string-wrong-type
cases.note: Operations is present but not a list, so it is neither missing nor a list containing Uninstall: the only error is WrongType at Operations. Contrast doc-sel-named-source-uninstall-conflict.
